extract: K'aresh (/kɑːˈɹɛʃ/ kah-RESH) is the original homeworld of the ethereals and brokers. It was an arid planet, home to a thriving ecosystem and several sentient species until it was destroyed in the Devouring War, forcing the K'areshi into exodus across the Twisting Nether, the Shadowlands, and on shattered remnants surrounding the planet's husk. Most K'areshi believed Dimensius the All-Devouring was responsible for their planet's destruction. In truth, the Ravel shattered the planet in an attempt to kill the void lord before he could consume K'aresh, knowing the planet was doomed either way. Like Azeroth, K'aresh had a worldsoul, which was referred to in the masculine sense. It had twin suns named Meter and Ti'meter that gave the sky a saffron blood-orange sky, which was consumed by Dimensius along with both suns.

It was an arid planet, home to a thriving ecosystem and several sentient species[[Ask CDev#Ask CDev Answers - Round 1|Ask CDev - Round 1]] until it was destroyed in the [[Devouring War]],{{text|yell|[[Thaumaturge Vashreen]]|My people lost their world to the void years ago and were scattered to the winds.}} forcing the [[K'areshi]] into exodus across the [[Twisting Nether]], the [[Shadowlands]], and on shattered remnants surrounding the planet's husk. Most K'areshi believed [[Dimensius the All-Devouring]] was responsible for their planet's destruction. In truth, the [[Ravel]] shattered the planet in an attempt to kill the [[void lord]] before he could consume K'aresh, knowing the planet was doomed either way.[[Unwrapped and Unraveled]] Like [[Azeroth]], K'aresh had a [[worldsoul]], which was referred to in the masculine sense.[[Zah'ran#Quotes|Zah'ran's gossip]][[The Tabiqa]] post-cutscene gossip with Soul-Scribe It had twin suns named Meter and Ti'meter that gave the sky a saffron blood-orange sky, which was consumed by Dimensius along with both suns.''[[The Doom of K'aresh]]'', pg. 39[[Whispers from K'aresh]]''[[The Doom of K'aresh]]'', Chapter 3: Ethereum ==History== {{Main|K'areshi}} Prior to [[Dimensius]]'s arrival, the world of K'aresh was an arid planet, home to a thriving ecosystem and several sentient species, including the [[K'areshi]]. Led by [[Nexus-King Salhadaar|High Priest Salhadaar]] and the [[Council of Oracles]], their society was composed of a variety of city-states throughout the desert world, such as [[Tazavesh]] which was ruled by [[Nexus-Prince Bilaal|Bilaal]], [[Ma'nussa]], ruled by [[Nexus-Princess Ky'veza|Ky'veza]], along with [[Gastalt]], [[Dervashna]], [[Tingarla]], and [[Sufaad]]. There were also tribes of nomads that wandered the desert, stopping in cities to trade and put on shows.''[[The Doom of K'aresh]]'' The Oracles communed with [[K'aresh (worldsoul)|K'aresh's worldsoul]] through a ritual called the Tabiqa that allowed them to reaffirm their oaths with him and hear his song.[[The Oasis (quest)]][[Distribution of Power]] ===The Doom of K'aresh=== {{Novel-section}} [[File:The Doom of K'aresh - chapter 2 art.jpg|thumb|upright|A mural depicting the ancient K'areshi and a city under one of their shields.]] Many thousands of years ago[[Nexus-King Salhadaar (quest)]]''[[A Thousand Years of War]]'' (perhaps a hundred thousand or more{{Text|say|[[Outcast Hizfran]]|Your face, though, came to me in a vision-dream during the last days of the Devouring. [...] 'How long ago was that?' [...] Hmmm, a hundred thousand years, perhaps more?}}), [[Dimensius the All-Devouring|Dimensius]] invaded K'aresh, beginning an apocalyptic conflict that the K'areshi would call the [[Devouring War]]. According to [[Locus-Walker]], shortly before the invasion, his people began receiving a vision similar to the [[Radiant Song]].[[Radiant Warnings]] By the time the people realized that their world was warning them of the coming danger, it was already too late.[[The War Within (quest)]] How Dimensius found K'aresh is still hotly debated among the surviving [[ethereal]]s, but the effects of his coming were unmistakable: he opened countless [[Portal|gateways]] into the [[Void]] around the planet, bathing K'aresh in dark energies. The K'areshi hastily attempted to construct magical barriers around their cities, powered by the [[Reshii Ribbons]] which could convert all forms of energy, including the Void, into [[arcane]]. Although the dark energies were blocked, the prolonged exposure of arcane energy from the shields tore away the K'areshi's corporeal shells and infused their souls with enough energy to transform them into energy beings. This altered state proved to be a blessing in disguise, however, as their enhanced minds and magical abilities allowed the ethereals to fight Dimensius and his limited forces to a standstill. Over the years, however, Dimensius eventually grew powerful enough to summon armies of fellow void creatures, forcing the K'areshi to flee into the [[Twisting Nether]] and [[Shadowlands]], becoming [[ethereal]]s and [[broker]]s.[[Ask CDev#Ask CDev Answers - Round 1|Ask CDev - Round 1]][[Veni Vidi Ve'nari]] Some ethereals continued to live on the shattered remains of the planet, becoming known as [[Wastelanders]]. While many, including most of the ethereals and brokers, believe that K'aresh was destroyed by Dimensius, he did not actually succeed. Seeing that their home was going to be lost either way, the K'areshi [[Locus-Walker]] and [[Nari]], along with Dimensius's own harbinger [[Xal'atath]], made the decision to destroy the planet in order to kill Dimensius, preventing him from devouring [[K'aresh (worldsoul)|K'aresh's worldsoul]]. It was the only way for the K'areshi to survive.[[Unwrapped and Unraveled]] Fragments of Dimensius were scattered across the [[Great Dark Beyond]], and the ethereals and brokers would believe that their planet's destruction was his fault. Some ethereals still continued to live on the shattered remains of the planet, becoming known as [[Wastelanders]]. They were led by [[Soul-Scribe]] and sworn to Nexus-King Salhadaar.[[An Outcast's Request]] During the final days of the Devouring War, a blue mineral began to surface and was called the [[Blood of K'aresh]].[[The Blood of K'aresh]] ===The Burning Crusade=== {{Bc-section}} During the [[invasion of Outland]] in 26 [[ADP]], the [[Ethereum]] still kept a presence on the remains of K'aresh, maintaining a connection to [[Outland]] in [[Bash'ir Landing]].{{text|yell|[[The Grand Collector]]|They called me down from K'aresh to deal with this band of misfits?}} Some of the [[Void]] creatures who had served under Dimensius during the [[Devouring War]] were bound in service to the scattered ethereals, including [[Nexus-Prince Shaffar]]'s [[Shaffar's ethereals|independent faction]] operating in the [[Mana Tombs]] of [[Auchindoun]].[[Pandemonius#Adventure Guide]] ===Cataclysm=== {{Cata-section}} Following the [[Cataclysm (event)|Cataclysm]] in 28 ADP, the [[mage]] [[Umbranse the Spiritspeaker]] opened several portals within [[Mazthoril]], which were connected to a number of worlds across both the [[Great Dark Beyond]] and [[Twisting Nether]], including K'aresh.[[The Arcane Storm Within]] Hostile ethereals of unknown affiliation who still resided on the broken world used these portals to access [[Azeroth]]. An [[adventurer]] was tasked by the [[blue dragon]] [[Haleh]] to seal these portals, closing off the connection between worlds.[[The Arcane Storm Within]] ===The War Within=== {{Tww-section}} {{Main|War on K'aresh}} [[File:Ghosts of K'aresh 2.png|thumb|left|The remains of K'aresh and the [[Manaforge Omega]].]] After her time in the [[Maw]] and [[Zereth Mortis]], [[Ve'nari]]'s vision of restoring K'aresh had become a prevailing idea among the [[broker]]s, gaining her enough influence to take over [[Cartel Om]] and enough fortune to outright purchase [[Tazavesh]] as a shipping port, making it a recreation center for [[Project Eco-Dome]] -- a revitalization effort led by Ve'nari to restore K'aresh with modified [[eco-dome]]s purchased from and constructed by the [[Consortium]].[[Geologist Om'tik#Quotes]][[Restoring Operational Efficiency]], stay a while and listen with [[Locus-Walker]] With her newfound societal and financial power, Ve'nari founded the [[K'aresh Trust]], reuniting [[ethereal]]s and brokers for the first time in millenia through the union of various broker cartels, along with the ethereals of the Consortium and [[Protectorate]], with the common purpose of revitalizing the remains of their common homeworld. While Tazavesh was moved back to K'aresh, [[Azir|Nexus-Prince Azir]] took the [[Dark Heart]] to [[Manaforge Omega]], a colossal [[Shadowguard]] facility, and began the process to resurrect the [[void lord]] [[Dimensius]], whose voice could be heard across the broken world.[[A Shadowy Invitation#notes]] During the course of the [[war on K'aresh]], [[Xal'atath]] entered into an uneasy alliance with the K'aresh Trust, and discovered that the [[Wastelanders]]' true desire was to hear the song of [[K'aresh (worldsoul)|K'aresh's worldsoul]] once more, as they had once been the Oracles of the Worldsoul.[[Before the Void]] After they succeeded to hear K'aresh' song through a ritual, [[Soul-Scribe]] pledged her Wastelanders forces to the restoration of the world and surrendered her [[Reshii Ribbons]] to the [[adventurer]]s.[[The Tabiqa]] The Trust forces stationed at [[Shan'dorah]] later led a counterattack on [[Shadow Point]], where the Shadowguard forces outside [[Manaforge Omega]] were stationed, feeding energy from K'aresh itself into Dimensius within the Manaforge.[[Adverse Instantiation]][[And We Will Answer]] [[File:K'aresh reborn.jpg|thumb|With the sacrifice of [[Soul-Scribe]] to strengthen the [[K'aresh (worldsoul)|world soul]], K'aresh is reborn anew.]] After the heroes defeated the All-Devouring, they found a [[A Dimmed Crystal|dimmed crystal]], which Ve'nari quickly identified as the essence of K'aresh and that while diminished, it was not beyond saving.[[A Lullaby of Hope]] After the adventurers defeated Soul-Scribe at [[Eco-Dome Al'dani]], Ve'nari showed her the last fragment of the Worldsoul, before asking which oath she would follow. Choosing her oath to K'aresh over her oath to [[Nexus-King Salhadaar]], Soul-Scribe allowed Ve'nari to unbind her with her own [[:Tabiqa Dagger]]. Her untethered soul then stepped into the Worldsoul's light, giving her life and the last of her energy to heal it. The K'areshi remained in cursed bodies, and many still followed the Shadowguard into the [[Void]] of their own accord, but at least K'aresh itself would endure and live once more.[[Eco-Dome Al'dani#Narrative]] The success of Project Eco-Dome would later pave the way for the return of flora and fauna to K'aresh. Having been aided by adventurers and experts from [[Azeroth]] and beyond; Ve'nari was able to establish a stable ecosystem within the [[Oasis]] eco-dome. Though it took much effort, the success of this project made it clear that, eventually, K'aresh could be restored anew.[[The Hope of K'aresh]][[Ecological Succession]] storyline. ==Getting there== In the second quest of the [[Ghosts of K'aresh campaign]], players unlock a Spatial Rift portal to [[Tazavesh, the Veiled Market]] at {{co|40.3|22.8|Dornogal}} in the [[Foundation Hall]] of [[Dornogal]] (near the portal to [[Stormwind]] and teleporter to the top of the building). The rift drops players off at {{co|62.1|92.9|Tazavesh||1}} at the south end of Tazavesh, just in front of the return portal back to Dornogal. K'aresh has flight enabled from the outset, and flight is required to navigate the zone. *{{RaceIcon|VoidCrawler}} [[Voidcrawler]]s }} ==Storyline== {{main|Ghosts of K'aresh campaign}} The primary campaign has players get to Tazavesh and K'aresh from Dornogal and work to fight against [[Dimensius]]'s return. The campaign is five chapters long, and chapters four and five are gated behind the second week of the patch, first made available the week of 12 August 2025, and will send players into [[Manaforge Omega]] and [[Eco-Dome Al'dani]] to conclude the story. ==Activities== ===Phase Diving and Reshii Wraps=== [[File:11.2 Phase Diving.png|thumb|[[Phase Diving]]]] Unlocked after completing chapter three of the campaign (ending with [[The Tabiqa]]), players acquire their [[Reshii Wraps]], an artifact-level cloak, which are necessary to enter [[Manaforge Omega]] as well as begin [[Phase Diving]]. While Phase Diving, players will find different rare enemies and treasures from the normal phase of K'aresh, and can acquire several mounts and pets including the [[Phase-Lost Slateback]] and [[Lavender K'arroc]]. {{Diving Into Phase Diving}} ===Warrants=== [[Warrants]] are unlocked at Renown 3 with the [[K'aresh Trust]], tasking players with defeating a different creature each week. Find [[Constable Zo'ardaz]] in [[Tazavesh]] to begin. Completing all six warrants will reward the [[Terror of the Night]] mount. ===Ecological Succession=== Unlocked after completing chapter four of the campaign (ending with [[That's a Wrap]]), [[Ve'nari]] has players help her colonize the [[Oasis]] with wildlife that will survive and thrive with [[Ecological Succession]]. {{The Oasis}} After finishing the introduction questline and weekly campaign quest, the weekly wrapper world quest [[Ecological Succession (world quest)]] opens up, which rewards the [[Wriggling Pinnacle Cache]] that can contain the [[Curious Slateback]] mount and one of twelve pets. ==Collectables== {{columns|3| ;Mounts *[[Acidic Void Creeper]] -
